question: Where can I get a list of stand-alone battery storage (BESS) projects currently in permitting in Germany, with location, power (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: No single German registry tracks BESS in permitting. Most stand-alone BESS are not BImSchG-listed and undergo confidential district Baugenehmigung (~400 authorities; >=4 MW within 200 m of substations privileged per § 35(1) Nr.12 BauGB since 23.12.2025) or municipal Bebauungsplan procedures. Closest official source is BNetzA's MaStR (753 planned >=1 MW units, 13.1 GW; 303 non-EEG/non-backup), but pre-grant filing is voluntary and only 65 hold post-grant permit data. Municipal consultations publish unstructured on UVP-Verbund and state DiPlanung/Bauleitplanung portals; EC JRC (WoodMac-backed) adds partial pipeline data.
main_caveats: Pre-permit MaStR registration is voluntary for non-BImSchG projects; 753 planned >=1 MW BESS in MaStR vs 18,158 grid requests (573.5 GW) and 1,937 commitments (54.2 GW) in 2025.

Pending Baugenehmigungen (~400 district Bauaufsichtsbehörden) are non-public administrative files; MaStR's Genehmigung schema requires a mandatory grant date (Datum), so pending applications cannot appear there.
No explicit stand-alone boolean exists in MaStR: 443/753 planned >=1 MW units link to an EEG facility (many PV+BESS), while 303 non-EEG/non-backup units serve as an imperfect stand-alone proxy.
276/753 planned >=1 MW MaStR battery units already carry overdue planned commissioning dates (< 2026-11-15), inflating the apparent active pipeline.
MaStR list JSON returns GenehmigungRegistrierungsdatum (upload date), not actual Genehmigungsdatum / DatumDerAntragstellung (which require scraping unit detail HTML or parsing the 3.2 GB XML dump).
answer.confidence_reason: Direct inspection of MaStR XSD/PDF schemas (rev 26.2), live API queries (753 records >=1 MW), MaStRV legal text (§§ 5, 15), BNetzA/SMARD reports, UVP portals, and state DiPlanung procedures confirms exact structural gaps.

attributes.note: MaStR provides municipality for 753/753 planned >=1 MW units, parcels for 539/753, and lat/lon in DE for 744/753 (9 masked). JRC adds coords.
MaStR reports Bruttoleistung & Nettonennleistung in kW (divide by 1000 for MW) plus NutzbareSpeicherkapazitaet in kWh. JRC reports MW & MWh.
MaStR exposes AnlagenbetreiberName (operator/SPV) for 698/753 legal entities >=1 MW.
attributes.gap_note: Natural-person owners are withheld per § 15(1) Nr.2 MaStRV (55/753 >=1 MW unshown); EC JRC publishes no developer column.

attributes.note: MaStR shows BetriebsStatus='In Planung' + linked SGE permits (65/753); JRC uses Announced (618), Permitted (8), Under construction (19).
attributes.gap_note: Pending Baugenehmigung and § 3(1)/§ 3(2) BauGB consultation milestones are not tracked in MaStR or JRC, only in municipal/UVP notices.

attributes.note: MaStR list API gives EinheitRegistrierungsdatum, GeplantesInbetriebsnahmeDatum, and GenehmigungRegistrierungsdatum (65/753).
attributes.gap_note: List API omits Datum and DatumDerAntragstellung (found on detail HTML/XML for 65 granted permits only); JRC omits all permitting dates.

key_fields.meaning: Unique unit identifier (SEE...); Id maps to public HTML detail page /MaStR/Einheit/Detail/IndexOeffentlich/{Id}
Gross electrical power in kW (divide by 1000 for MW)
Usable energy storage capacity in kWh
Operational status: 31 = In Planung, 35 = In Betrieb, 37 = Vorübergehend stillgelegt, 38 = Endgültig stillgelegt
Legal-entity operator/SPV name (withheld for natural persons)
WGS84 latitude (plus Laengengrad longitude, Gemeinde, Flurstueck)
Linked EEG installation ID (presence indicates co-located/EEG-coupled system; absent for 303 non-backup planned units >=1 MW)
Linked SGE permit ID (present on only 65/753 >=1 MW planned BESS, alongside Genehmigungbehoerde, AktenzeichenGenehmigung, GenehmigungRegistrierungsdatum)

steps: Paginate page=1..ceil(Total/250) on GetErweiterteOeffentlicheEinheitStromerzeugung with filter Betriebs-Status='31', Energieträger='2496', Speichertechnologie='524', Land='84', Bruttoleistung>999 for >=1 MW planned BESS.
Convert Bruttoleistung (kW) / 1000 -> MW and parse /Date(ms)/ timestamps to ISO dates.
Optionally filter out EegAnlageMastrNummer != null and IsEinheitNotstromaggregat == true to approximate stand-alone grid BESS (303 of 753 units; 10,915.5 MW).

To retrieve permit grant date (Genehmigungsdatum), application date (DatumDerAntragstellung), permit type (Art der Genehmigung), and AC/DC coupling, fetch /MaStR/Einheit/Detail/IndexOeffentlich/{Id} or download EinheitenGenehmigung.xml & EinheitenStromSpeicher.xml inside the daily 3.2 GB Gesamtdatenexport ZIP at /MaStR/Datendownload.
reading_traps: GenehmigungRegistrierungsdatum in the JSON list API is when the operator registered the permit in MaStR, NOT when the authority issued it or when the application was filed.
276 of 753 planned >=1 MW units already have GeplantesInbetriebsnahmeDatum < 2026-11-15 (stale/delayed entries never updated or cancelled).

Voluntary pre-grant filing means most active municipal Bebauungsplan and district Baugenehmigung pipelines are absent here; BNetzA counted 1,937 grid connection commitments (54.2 GW) in 2025 vs 753 units >=1 MW (13.1 GW) in MaStR.
BESS units <=1 MW or behind-the-meter industrial storage can appear if Bruttoleistung threshold is lowered (30,952 planned battery units exist across all sizes, mostly residential).

problems: Unfiltered queries return Total=0; technology and country filters are required.
records_total=2,948,611 represents all German battery storage units (all statuses/sizes); 30,952 are In Planung across all sizes; 753 are In Planung >=1 MW.

evidence.claim: Project registration duty in MaStR triggers only within 1 month AFTER permit grant for BImSchG/WindSeeG/federal approvals
evidence.quote: Betreiber müssen ihre Projekte im Marktstammdatenregister gemäß Absatz 5 registrieren, wenn die Errichtung oder der Betrieb der Stromerzeugungseinheit einer Zulassung nach dem Bundes-Immissionsschutzgesetz, dem Windenergie-auf-See-Gesetz oder sonstigem Bundesrecht bedarf und die Zulassung erteilt wurde.

evidence.claim: EinheitenGenehmigung schema requires Datum (permit grant date) as mandatory field (Pflicht: Ja), precluding pending permits without a grant date
evidence.quote: Datum | Datum, ab dem die Genehmigung für Bau oder Betrieb der Stromerzeugungseinheit erteilt ist | date | Ja

Coordinates are frequently rounded to municipality centroids (e.g. 51.410000, 8.050000) and commissioningYear is null on all 662 German pre-operational records.

regulator.name: Bundesnetzagentur (BNetzA) for energy register/grid; BMWSB (federal building code BauGB) and state/district building authorities for permitting

operators.note: Permitting authority is split across ~400 Landkreise/kreisfreie Städte (untere Bauaufsichtsbehörden issuing confidential Baugenehmigungen under state LBO & § 35(1) Nr.12 BauGB), ~10,700 municipalities (Bebauungspläne), and regional authorities for rare BImSchG/UVP triggers. Stand-alone BESS lack an independent 4. BImSchV category; grid queues sit separately with 4 TSOs and >800 DSOs.

publication_obligation.norm: § 5 Abs. 4–5 & § 15 MaStRV; § 35 Abs. 1 Nr. 11–12 & §§ 3, 4a BauGB (BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 348); § 5 UVPG
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: MaStRV § 5(4)-(5) mandates project registration in MaStR within 1 month AFTER permit grant for BImSchG, WindSeeG, WHG, or federal-law permits, not before. State Baugenehmigungen are exempt from pre-grant MaStR obligation and are not published while pending; municipal Bebauungspläne require public consultation notices (§§ 3, 4a BauGB).
publication_obligation.frequency: MaStR updates live in UI and exports daily at ~05:00 CET; Bauleitplanung & UVP notices publish per procedural milestone.

consolidated_republication.note: Third-party portals (bess-market.com, bess-check.com, battery-charts.de, energiewende-dashboard.org) republish MaStR rather than permitting portals; JRC republishes proprietary Wood Mackenzie project records.

checked_pages.saw: Federal open data portal (165,423 datasets); CKAN package_search?q=Batteriespeicher returned 9 installed-capacity/GDI-DE datasets and 0 permitting lists.
Aggregates EIA and select land-use notices across all 16 Länder, but query 'Batteriespeicher' returns only 22 items (mostly forest conversion or co-located biogas § 16 BImSchG notices).
Open-source digital planning suite adopted by 7 Länder (HH, BE, BY, BB, HB, NI, SH), not a national single database; each state hosts its own portal (e.g. by.beteiligung.diplanung.de).
Regulatory/ancillary-service rules for BESS; publishes no project permitting queue or list.

national_registry.note: No national permitting registry tracks BESS currently in permitting. BNetzA's Marktstammdatenregister (MaStR) is the mandatory national electricity unit register and contains voluntary 'In Planung' units plus post-grant federal permits (65/753 >=1 MW), not active permit applications.

checked_pages.saw: Unit registry covering 753 planned >=1 MW BESS (30,952 all sizes), but pre-grant registration is voluntary for BauGB/LBO projects and SGE requires a mandatory grant date.
Publishes only aggregate counts/GW of grid requests (18,158 requests / 573.5 GW in 2025) and commitments (1,937 / 54.2 GW), with no project list or stand-alone split.
Federal EIA portal search for 'Batteriespeicher' returned 0 matches ('Die Suche mit den aktuellen Filtereinstellungen führte zu keinem Treffer.').

checked_pages.organization: Bundesministerium für Wohnen, Stadtentwicklung und Bauwesen (BMWSB)
checked_pages.saw: Federal building code (BauGB) hub; confirms planning/permitting execution rests with states and municipalities with no federal permit registry.
CKAN search for 'Batteriespeicher' found 9 statistical/GDI-DE layers and 0 permitting project datasets.

recipe: Pull MaStR Betriebs-Status=31, Energieträger=2496, Speichertechnologie=524, Bruttoleistung>999 and cross-match against EC JRC Germany pre-operational battery projects to establish a baseline pipeline.

Scrape UVP-Verbund (/freitextsuche?q=Batteriespeicher and /freitextsuche?q=Batteriespeicheranlage) across Bauleitplanung and Negative Vorprüfungen to capture EIA-screened BESS and forest-conversion triggers.

Crawl state Bauleitplanung portals—DiPlanBeteiligung portals (HH, BE, BY, BB, HB, NI, SH via diplanung.de) plus non-DiPlanung portals (bauleitplanung.nrw.de, beteiligung.nrw.de, BW/HE/SN portals)—filtering titles for 'Batteriespeicher', 'BESS', 'Energiespeicher', and 'Sondergebiet Speicher'.

For non-privileged projects not in state portals and for § 35(1) Nr. 12 BauGB privileged Baugenehmigungen, monitor municipal council RIS agendas for § 36 BauGB consent ('Einvernehmen' + 'Batteriespeicher') and download attached PDFs (Begründung) to extract developer name and MW.
if_unstructured.location_method: Extract Gemarkung and Flurstück parcel numbers from Bebauungsplan/UVP notices and geocode via state ALKIS/Geoportal WFS services; for MaStR records, validate Breitengrad/Laengengrad directly against parcel boundaries and substations.
cross_with: ALKIS cadastral parcel layers (via state surveying authorities / Geoportal.de) to turn Gemarkung + Flurstück into exact polygons.
High/extra-high-voltage substation locations (OSMap/TSO network maps) because § 35(1) Nr. 12 BauGB limits stand-alone privilege to <=200 m of eligible substations/power plants.
SMARD / BNetzA grid request statistics and TSO milestone guidance (Reifegradverfahren) to calibrate attrition and unbuilt speculative queues.
